t: Slim and lightweight rechargeable head torch for everday use. Features a spot to flood focusing system where white light sources are complemented by a third red light source for night vision preservation. A tilt mechanism up to 45° directs the light beam for optimum illumination. A slim headband can be easily adjusted. Fuss-free charging of the integrated battery is provided by the magnetic contact charge system. Also includes battery indicators and a transport lock mode to prevent accidental battery drain.
